questions.prompt: Which component carries room media between participants?
questions.explanation: The media server handles room transport. Agent code and model services have separate roles.

questions.prompt: A room exists but no agent has joined. What should you inspect?
options: Only the STT word error rate
questions.explanation: Room creation and agent dispatch are separate steps. Check whether a job was requested and accepted.

questions.prompt: A local voice agent connects but fails to answer. What is the best next step?
options: Trace input audio, model response and output audio separately
Assume connection success proves the voice pipeline
questions.explanation: Connection success proves little about recognition, generation or playback. Inspect each boundary.
